question: restaurants inside commercial buildings
sql: SELECT p.names."primary" AS place_name, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.class FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND b.subtype = 'commercial';

question: buildings touching schools, return geojson
sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.class, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geom FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_buildings s ON ST_Touches(b.geometry, s.geometry) WHERE s.class = 'school' AND b.id <> s.id;

question: cafes in buildings over 20m tall
sql: SELECT p.names."primary" AS cafe_name, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.height FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE p.basic_category = 'cafe' AND b.height > 20;

question: permanently closed places still inside building footprints
sql: SELECT p.names."primary" AS place_name, p.operating_status, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.subtype FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) WHERE p.operating_status = 'permanently_closed';

question: building footprints overlapping other buildings, not just touching
sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.class FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_buildings o ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, o.geometry) AND NOT ST_Touches(b.geometry, o.geometry) WHERE b.id <> o.id;

question: residential buildings with no places inside
sql: SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.class FROM lisbon_buildings b WHERE b.subtype = 'residential' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lisbon_places p WHERE ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry));
